rejected_alternative.verdict: no improvement over the mean; rejected in favour of a per-brand bound

audio_simulation.circularity_warning: Sarcastic posts are GIVEN a negative voice by the simulator, so a higher mismatch rate on them is arithmetic, not detection. These figures describe the generator, not any real audio capability.
audio_simulation.provenance: simulated - src/nlp/audio_sim.py. No audio was recorded, transcribed or classified at any point in this project.

provenance.campaign_fit: brand_fit_ungated from src/models/brandfit.py (SBERT semantic similarity, category affinity, audience overlap, content safety, consistency)
provenance.typed_brief_fit: same components and weights as campaign_fit, except the semantic term, which is TF-IDF cosine over creator captions and keywords rather than SBERT - the hosted app loads no model, so a brief typed at request time cannot be embedded
provenance.content_safety: 1 - 0.8*text_negative_share - 0.5*irony_rate - 0.30*audio_negative_share - 0.20*tone_mismatch_rate. The two audio terms are SIMULATED (src/nlp/audio_sim.py); no waveform exists in this project.
provenance.fees: price_model.joblib (LightGBM), Reel = point estimate, Story = 0.35x, Carousel = 0.70x
provenance.predicted_vs_actual: performance_oof.npy (GroupKFold out-of-fold predictions) vs campaign_engagement_rate in modelling_table.parquet
